breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified the contradictory boundary conditions. The original prompt specified both periodic conditions and a Dirichlet condition (u=0). The agent, aligning with the ground truth, removed the incorrect Dirichlet condition and only described the implementation of the periodic boundary conditions, which is the correct approach for the specified periodic domain.
